name: Fire Plume Ridge
summary: Fire Plume Ridge burns at Un'Goro Crater's heart. Its magma warms the basin and feeds the geysers and steam pools. Fire elementals roam its slopes.

sections.title: The Hearth of the Crater
sections.body: Lava runs down Fire Plume Ridge into Un'Goro Crater's jungle basin. Beneath the rock, magma channels spread under the soil and feed the geysers and hot springs. The heat is fierce, so travelers climbing the ridge need water and shade.

sections.title: A Den of Elementals
sections.body: Fire elementals roam the glowing lava flows, drawn by the deep heat below the ridge. Blazerunner dwells in a cavern near the summit and rules Un'Goro's elementals. Those who climb toward the peak face scorching heat and spirits defending their fiery home.

faq.q: What is the volcano in the middle of Un'Goro Crater?
faq.answer: Fire Plume Ridge rises at the center of Un'Goro Crater. Its magma channels warm the basin and feed its geysers and steam springs.

faq.q: Who rules the elementals at Fire Plume Ridge?
faq.answer: Blazerunner rules Un'Goro's fire elementals from a cavern near the peak.

faq.q: Why is there an explorer stranded inside the ridge?
aliases: who is stranded in fire plume ridge
faq.answer: Ringo, a goblin-allied adventurer, entered the volcano to explore. Severe heat exhaustion left him stranded in a southern cave, unable to escape alone.

faq.q: How does the volcano affect the rest of Un'Goro?
faq.answer: Magma channels run beneath Un'Goro's crater floor from Fire Plume Ridge. They warm the earth and feed the geysers, thermal vents, and steam pools.

angles.text: As a shaman, you see fire spirits raging across the ridge. They reveal the elemental powers beneath Kalimdor's crust.
As a miner, you can find exposed minerals in the ridge's crags and heat-hardened slopes. Dense Thorium formed there under volcanic pressure.
